content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Introduction to Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Ethical hacking and penetration testing are critical components of modern cybersecurity. By proactively identifying and addressing vulnerabilities before malicious actors can exploit them, organizations can significantly strengthen their security posture."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"What is Ethical Hacking?"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Ethical hacking involves authorized attempts to bypass system security to identify potential data breaches and vulnerabilities in a computer system or network. Unlike malicious hackers, ethical hackers operate with explicit permission and adhere to strict legal and ethical guidelines."},{"order":5,"type":"subheading","text":"Penetration Testing Phases"},{"order":6,"type":"paragraph","text":"A standard penetration testing engagement typically follows a structured framework divided into five primary phases:"},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"1. Planning and Reconnaissance: Defining the scope and gathering intelligence about the target."},{"order":8,"type":"bullet_point","text":"2. Scanning: Utilizing tools like Nmap to understand how the target application responds to various intrusion attempts."},{"order":9,"type":"bullet_point","text":"3. Gaining Access: Using web application attacks, SQL injection, and backdoors to uncover vulnerabilities."},{"order":10,"type":"bullet_point","text":"4. Maintaining Access: Ensuring the vulnerability persists to assess deep-level damage."},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"5. Analysis and Reporting: Documenting findings, risks, and remediation strategies."},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Basic Reconnaissance with Nmap"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"Network scanning is the first step in discovering active hosts and open ports. Below is a common command used to perform a basic TCP SYN scan."},{"order":14,"type":"code","text":"nmap -sS -p 1-1000 192.168.1.100"},{"order":15,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":16,"type":"paragraph","text":"Mastering ethical hacking requires continuous learning, hands-on practice in safe lab environments, and a deep understanding of networking and operating systems. Always ensure you have written authorization before testing any system."}]
